Hi, I'm Samina. I work on pricing, forecasting and demand models. Before this, I did an MS (Research) at IIT Madras, where I ran survey studies and tested behavioural hypotheses with statistical models.

I'm interested in pricing, causal inference and experiments. I use this site to write up projects I've worked on and things I'm learning.

## Education

**IIT Madras** | MS (Research), Department of Management Studies\
Research at the intersection of industrial-organizational psychology and quantitative methods: designing survey-based studies and testing behavioral hypotheses with statistical models, including moderation, mediation and conditional process analysis (SPSS, PROCESS).

**University of Mumbai** | B.Tech, Electronics Engineering | 2021

## Experience

**Accenture Strategy & Consulting** | Decision Science Analyst | 2025 – present\
Building pricing, forecasting and demand-sourcing models for industrial clients.

**American Express, Data Analytics & Risk Tech. Lab (via IIT Madras)** | Research Associate | 2023 – 2025
